name: Miden
source:
An Embryo maiden dressed in the Eastern style with Miko robes. Her demeanor is soft when talking to others, but she was secretly charged with a destructive mission.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
